items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And also another one that called me his favorite bebop flutist was Charlie Mariano. I haven’t seen him for a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah, well that helps, doesn’t it.

But he did like that. But he came into a club I was in in New York and as he came in he goes, “There’s Sam Most, the world’s greatest jazz flute player” whether he meant it or not. But it was nice. And also another one that called me his favorite bebop flutist was Charlie Mariano. I haven’t seen him for a long time. And okay.

You know, you asked Lester Young a question about what do you think about when you’re improvising and he gave you that answer. What if I ask you the same question. Is it possible to put it into words?
